Code blocks in replies look closer to the desktop app: boxes fit their code, the copy button is always there, and inline code no longer shouts in the error color.

- A code block is as wide as its longest line (at least 24 columns) instead of stretching across the whole screen; long lines still wrap at the screen edge
- The `⧉ copy` button sits dimmed beside the top-right corner of every code block, without hovering, so keyboard and phone users can see it too. It stays out of the code while you scroll
- Inline code keeps its shaded background but uses the normal text color instead of the error color
- A code block right under a list item's text no longer has a blank line above it, so the spacing above and below matches
- desk-asana and desk-slack messages get the same code block and inline code look; desk-plan and desk-review move to 0.78.0 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
